title: Denim & Diamonds Boat Ride Party
audience: Women-centered community gathering; friends and community members welcome unless otherwise noted.
summary: A Denim & Diamonds themed boat ride party with scenic views, DJ Jerome, lunch, cash bar, and fabulous company by the sea.
description: Sisters of Sarasota by the Sea gathered for a dazzling afternoon where denim met diamonds aboard a scenic Sarasota boat ride. Guests enjoyed lunch, music by DJ Jerome, a cash bar, and the joy of gathering together beautifully.
ticketInfo: Tickets were available via Zelle at asheilabruceaffair@gmail.com.
